symbols.name: prime source length
symbols.meaning: The prime source length on axis i, an odd prime chosen close to t_i.
symbols.quote: Here $s_i$ is the $i$-th prime source length, an odd prime, and $t_i$ is the $i$-th padded axis length, a power of two.

symbols.name: padded axis length
symbols.meaning: The padded length of axis i, a power of two.
symbols.quote: Here $s_i$ is the $i$-th prime source length, an odd prime, and $t_i$ is the $i$-th padded axis length, a power of two.

symbols.name: window width parameter
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant with 0 < eta < 1/4 that sets the width of the window for s_i.
symbols.quote: where $\eta$ is a fixed constant with $0<\eta<1/4$ that sets the window width.

relations.quote: Distinct primes give pairwise coprime lengths for the [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md), which turns one cyclic convolution into a multidimensional one.
Second, each ratio $t_i/s_i$ must leave enough separation for [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md), which moves between transforms of length $s_i$ and of length $t_i$.
